checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-config-surface.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); mkdir -p "$tmp/home" "$tmp/repo"; HOME="$tmp/home" "$tmp/ao" config --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'ao config [flags]' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'models      Show model cost tier configuration' "$tmp/help"; HOME="$tmp/home" "$tmp/ao" config >"$tmp/noargs"; grep -Fq 'View and manage AgentOps configuration.' "$tmp/noargs"; HOME="$tmp/home" "$tmp/ao" --json config --show >"$tmp/show.json"; jq -e '.output.value != null and .dream_report_dir.value != null' "$tmp/show.json" >/dev/null; HOME="$tmp/home" "$tmp/ao" --json config models >"$tmp/models.json"; jq -e '.default_tier == "balanced" and (.tiers|length) == 3' "$tmp/models.json" >/dev/null; (cd "$tmp/repo" && HOME="$tmp/home" "$tmp/ao" config models --set-tier quality >"$tmp/write.out"); grep -qx 'Set default model tier to "quality"' "$tmp/write.out"; grep -q 'default_tier: quality' "$tmp/repo/.agentops/config.yaml"; set +e; HOME="$tmp/home" "$tmp/ao" config junk >"$tmp/junk.out" 2>"$tmp/junk.err"; junk=$?; HOME="$tmp/home" "$tmp/ao" config models --set-tier premium >"$tmp/bad.out" 2>"$tmp/bad.err"; bad=$?; set -e; test "$junk" -eq 1; test "$bad" -eq 1; grep -qx 'Error: unknown command "junk" for "ao config"' "$tmp/junk.err"; grep -q 'Error: invalid tier "premium"' "$tmp/bad.err"
